name: Build PDF from Markdown & Release on: push: branches: [main, master] paths: - '**.md' - '.github/workflows/markdown-to-pdf.yml' workflow_dispatch: permissions: contents: write jobs: build-and-release: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Checkout repository uses: actions/checkout@v4 with: fetch-depth: 0 - name: Set up Python uses: actions/setup-python@v5 with: python-version: '3.11' - name: Install system dependencies run: | sudo apt-get update sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \ pandoc \ texlive-xetex \ texlive-fonts-recommended \ texlive-latex-recommended \ texlive-latex-extra \ lmodern \ librsvg2-bin - name: Install Python dependencies run: | python -m pip install --upgrade pip pip install markdown-filter - name: Collect and merge Markdown files id: collect run: | set -euo pipefail python - <<'PY' import os, glob from pathlib import Path # Ignore common non-content paths ignore_dirs = {'.git', 'node_modules', 'vendor', 'dist', 'build', '.github'} md_files = [] for path in Path('.').rglob('*.md'): if any(part in ignore_dirs for part in path.parts): continue md_files.append(path) md_files.sort(key=lambda p: str(p)) print(f"Found {len(md_files)} markdown file(s)") out = Path('combined.md') with out.open('w', encoding='utf-8') as f: # Title page f.write('# Repository Documentation\n\n') f.write(f'_Generated: {os.popen("date -u +%Y-%m-%d").read().strip()}_\n\n') f.write('---\n\n') for i, md in enumerate(md_files): print(f"Processing: {md}") f.write(f'\n\n# {md.name}\n\n') try: content = md.read_text(encoding='utf-8') except Exception as e: print(f" Skipping {md}: {e}") continue f.write(content) f.write('\n\n---\n\n') print(f"Wrote combined.md ({out.stat().st_size} bytes)") PY - name: Convert to PDF with Pandoc run: | set -euo pipefail pandoc combined.md \ -o documentation.pdf \ --from gfm \ --pdf-engine=xelatex \ --toc \ --toc-depth=3 \ --number-sections \ -V geometry:margin=2cm \ -V mainfont="DejaVu Sans" \ -V monofont="DejaVu Sans Mono" \ -V fontsize=10pt \ -V colorlinks=true \ -V linkcolor=blue \ -V urlcolor=blue \ -V toccolor=blue \ --highlight-style=tango \ --standalone - name: Verify PDF was created run: | if [ ! -f documentation.pdf ]; then echo "ERROR: documentation.pdf was not created" exit 1 fi ls -lh documentation.pdf - name: Generate release tag id: tag run: | echo "tag=v$(date -u +'%Y.%m.%d-%H%M%S')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" echo "date=$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" - name: Create or update GitHub Release id: release uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2 with: tag_name: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }} name: "Documentation PDF ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}" body: | Auto-generated PDF from Markdown sources. **Build:** ${{ github.run_number }} **Commit:** `${{ github.sha }}` **Date:** ${{ steps.tag.outputs.date }} files: documentation.pdf draft: false prerelease: false make_latest: true generate_release_notes: false env: GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} - name: Notify ntfy.sh if: always() env: NTFY_TOPIC: az_alerts STATUS: ${{ job.status }} RELEASE_URL: ${{ steps.release.outputs.url }} TAG: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }} REPO: ${{ github.repository }} REF: ${{ github.ref_name }} run: | set -euo pipefail if [ "$STATUS" = "success" ]; then TITLE="✅ PDF Build Succeeded" PRIORITY="default" TAGS="white_check_mark,book" else TITLE="❌ PDF Build Failed" PRIORITY="high" TAGS="x,warning" fi if [ -n "${RELEASE_URL:-}" ]; then BODY="Repo: ${REPO} (${REF}) Tag: ${TAG} Release: ${RELEASE_URL} Run: https://github.com/${REPO}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}" else BODY="Repo: ${REPO} (${REF}) Status: ${STATUS} Run: https://github.com/${REPO}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}" fi # ntfy accepts headers - avoid leaking newlines into headers curl -sS --fail-with-body \ -H "Title: ${TITLE}" \ -H "Priority: ${PRIORITY}" \ -H "Tags: ${TAGS}" \ -H "Click: ${RELEASE_URL:-https://github.com/${REPO}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}}" \ -H "Actions: view, Open Release, ${RELEASE_URL:-https://github.com/${REPO}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}}, clear=true" \ -d "${BODY}" \ "https://ntfy.sh/${NTFY_TOPIC}" || echo "ntfy notification failed (non-fatal)"
